user.title: Connect to Tody
user.description: In the Tody app, create an invite for a new participant (for example "Home Assistant") and enter the invite code here. Home Assistant only reads your tasks; it never marks tasks as done.

data_description.invite_code: The invite code shown in the Tody app when inviting someone to your data sync.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Tody
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant lost access to your Tody data sync. Create a new invite in the Tody app for the same data sync and enter the code here.

data_description.invite_code: A fresh invite code for the same Tody data sync.

error.invalid_code: The invite code is unknown or has expired.

abort.already_configured: This Tody data sync is already configured.
abort.wrong_sync: The invite code belongs to a different Tody data sync.
abort.api_key_missing: The Firebase API key in custom_components/tody/const.py has not been filled in. See the README.

data_description.lookahead_days: Besides overdue tasks and tasks due today, also show tasks due within this many days (0-7).
data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch tasks from Tody (5-240 minutes).
